annotations.title: Monthly budget in a Dutch city: net pay minus rent and fixed costs

description: What is left each month in a Dutch city: net salary (2026 tax, optional 30% ruling and holiday allowance) minus a typical unregulated-sector rent for the home size in that city, the basic health insurance premium (less any healthcare allowance), an average energy bill and the municipal charges for a renter. Cities with their own figures: Amsterdam, Amstelveen, Haarlem, The Hague, Rotterdam, Utrecht, Eindhoven, Helmond, Leeuwarden, Zwolle; any other city uses the national average rent and leaves out municipal charges. Food, transport, internet and water board charges are not included.

adults.description: Adults in the household (each pays health insurance). Default 1.

gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in euros, without holiday allowance

holiday_allowance.description: Gets 8% holiday allowance (spread over 12 months here). Default true.

home_size_m2.description: Size of the rented home in m². Default 60.

monthly_rent.description: Actual monthly rent if known, instead of the city average (optional)
